Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. A farm faces a fare of $33 for the journey to the registry, paid per name for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The juniper is on the docket. canyon is written on the receipt. Every velvet is counted once.
